item: Row 288 batch 6: 91 more test files open their SQLite engines with the app's pragmas
summary: 120 bare create_engine calls in 91 test files (none touched by an open PR) now go through tests/_app_engine.py::app_sqlite_engine, so they run with the app's foreign keys, WAL, busy timeout and cache settings; the converted files and every test file importing one of them pass. test_vacuum_space_preflight.py stays bare because it sets the journal mode itself per case (WAL or not), which is what it measures. The ratchet ceiling goes from 217 to 97 calls in 73 files. Test-only, no release line.
